whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Sweep every enemy around you. A broad physical strike.

dash_strike.name: Dash Strike
dash_strike.description: Rush forward with brief protection, then deliver a heavy strike.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Launch an ember that explodes and burns nearby foes.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.description: A ring of frost damages and slows nearby enemies for four seconds.

arcane_missiles.name: Arcane Missiles
arcane_missiles.description: Three quick bolts fan toward enemies ahead of you.

heal.name: Mending Light
heal.description: Restore 25% maximum HP, then regenerate another 12% over three seconds.
